title: Signal: Yarn TLS certificate validation disabled
scope: A .yarnrc.yml file that declares a Yarn setting that disables certificate validation.
limitations: It matches a Yarn setting that disables certificate validation in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .yarnrc.yml that mentions a Yarn setting that disables certificate validation in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
